turns.prompt_text: why do you unlock a lock with a bobby pin instead of a paper clip
turns.response_html: Lockpicking requires a tension wrench and a pick to manipulate the internal pins. A bobby pin's material and shape make it easier to bend into these two separate tools. You can make a tension wrench by bending one bobby pin into an L-shape, and a pick by straightening and curving the end of another.

turns.prompt_text: can you pick a lock with paper clips
turns.response_html: Yes, you can pick a lock with paper clips. You can bend one paper clip into a tension wrench and another into a pick to manipulate the lock's internal pins. However, they are generally less effective than bobby pins because the metal is softer and more likely to bend or break.
